title: eat shit & die 192
author: bpatrick
body: Thanks for the congratulations, everyone. I plan on continuing to make comics (I can’t help myself) but I do want to get as much into the summer of comics as possible.

comments.author: invertedquestionmark
comments.text: Had to read it three times to understand the idea and then I was like “Ooooh, that’s me again” 😀

comments.author: dawn storrud
comments.text: Good, no even better than good work

comments.author: David
comments.text: Very nice! You’ve captured something really complex here which I’ve recognised in myself as well.

comments.author: WolffBrosef2
comments.text: hmmm… good stuff. We should be careful not to let acts of love or kindness become all about other people seeing how good we are.
